_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Repairable Item Inspection Report
summary: The Repairable Item Inspection Report documents the contractor's inspection of a malfunctioning unit and the extent of repair performed, for Government evaluation of malfunctions and corrective action.
use_relationship:
The Repairable Item Inspection Report documents the contractor's inspection of the malfunctioning unit for repair and the extent of repair performed on the unit.
This data will be used by the Government to determine the types and quantity of unit malfunctions and evaluate the need for further corrective action.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
b. This DID is applicable to contractor repair contracts.
c. This DID supersedes DI-ILSS-80386.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Repairable Item Inspection Report shall be in the contractor's format

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The content of the report shall include the following data elements:

children.title: A listing of repair date codes on the unit.
Quantitative details stating the electrical and physical test requirements and parameters which the part does not meet.

A concise description of the extent of repair actions required to restore the malfunctioning unit to proper operation, including a list of all parts replaced and a description of all alignments or adjustments made.
Indicate cause of item malfunction with all quantitative details.
